functions.name: bind_telegram_bot
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."bind_telegram_bot"("p_user_id" "uuid", "p_chat_id" "text") RETURNS "void"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'public'
    AS $$
BEGIN
  -- Attempt to update the existing telegram channel record
  UPDATE notification_channels
  SET 
    is_enabled = true,
    config = jsonb_set(COALESCE(config, '{}'::jsonb), '{chat_id}', to_jsonb(p_chat_id))
  WHERE user_id = p_user_id AND channel_type = 'telegram';
  
  -- If the record doesn't exist yet, insert it
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    INSERT INTO notification_channels (user_id, channel_type, is_enabled, config)
    VALUES (p_user_id, 'telegram', true, jsonb_build_object('chat_id', p_chat_id));
  END IF;
END;
$$;

claim_instant_executions
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."claim_instant_executions"("p_execution_type" "text", "p_limit" integer) RETURNS SETOF "public"."topup_executions"
    LANGUAGE "sql"
    SET "search_path" TO ''
    AS $$
  UPDATE public.topup_executions
  SET status = 'processing',
      processing_since = NOW(),
      pre_processing_status = 'routing'
  WHERE id IN (
    SELECT id FROM public.topup_executions
    WHERE status = 'routing'
      AND execution_type = p_execution_type
    ORDER BY created_at ASC
    LIMIT p_limit
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
  )
  RETURNING *;
$$;

functions.name: get_current_context
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."get_current_context"() RETURNS json
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql"
    SET "search_path" TO 'public'
    AS $$
BEGIN
  RETURN json_build_object(
    'current_user', current_user,
    'session_user', session_user,
    'current_role', current_setting('role', true),
    'auth_role', auth.role(),
    'auth_uid', auth.uid(),
    'row_security', current_setting('row_security', true)
  );
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."update_execution_failed"("p_id" "uuid", "p_reason" "text") RETURNS "void"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO ''
    AS $$
BEGIN
  UPDATE public.topup_executions
  SET status = 'failed',
      failure_reason = p_reason,
      completed_at = NOW()
  WHERE id = p_id;
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."update_execution_status"("p_id" "uuid", "p_status" "text", "p_reloadly_transaction_id" "text") RETURNS "void"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO ''
    AS $$
BEGIN
  UPDATE public.topup_executions
  SET status = p_status,
      reloadly_transaction_id = p_reloadly_transaction_id,
      executed_at = NOW(),
      completed_at = NOW()
  WHERE id = p_id;
END;
$$;

functions.name: update_execution_status
functions.types: uuid, text, text, text, text, text
functions.identity: p_id uuid, p_status text, p_reloadly_transaction_id text, p_pin_code text, p_pin_serial text, p_redeem_instructions text
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."update_execution_status"("p_id" "uuid", "p_status" "text", "p_reloadly_transaction_id" "text", "p_pin_code" "text" DEFAULT NULL::"text", "p_pin_serial" "text" DEFAULT NULL::"text", "p_redeem_instructions" "text" DEFAULT NULL::"text") RETURNS "void"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO ''
    AS $$
BEGIN
  UPDATE public.topup_executions
  SET status = p_status,
      reloadly_transaction_id = p_reloadly_transaction_id,
      pin_code = COALESCE(p_pin_code, pin_code),
      pin_serial = COALESCE(p_pin_serial, pin_serial),
      redeem_instructions = COALESCE(p_redeem_instructions, redeem_instructions),
      executed_at = NOW(),
      completed_at = NOW()
  WHERE id = p_id;
END;
$$;
